'''Artur Oscar Lopes''' (born 17 October 1950 in the city of [[Rio de Janeiro]]) is a [[Brazilians|Brazilian]] [[writer]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Folha de S.Paulo - "Desengano" vence Jabuti em "romance" - 22/08/2007|url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/fsp/ilustrad/fq2208200715.htm|access-date=2021-01-20|website=www1.folha.uol.com.br}}</ref> and [[mathematician]] working on [[dynamical system]]s and [[ergodic theory]].<ref name="ABC">[https://web.archive.org/web/20151208055227/http://www.abc.org.br/~aol Academia Brasileira de Ciências – Artur Oscar Lopes]</ref> He is a professor at [[Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul|UFRGS]], [[Porto Alegre]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://mat.ufrgs.br/~alopes/|title = Artur Oscar Lopes}}</ref>

He earned his Ph.D. from the [[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada|IMPA]] in 1977 under the supervision of [[Jacob Palis]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=53020}}</ref>

He is a recipient of [[National Order of Scientific Merit (Brazil)|Brazil's National Order of Scientific Merit]] in mathematics.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mct.gov.br/index.php/content/view/11199/11199.html?nome=&area=Ci%EAncias+Matem%E1ticas&classificacao=&categoria=vivo|title=Portal do Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação|work=mct.gov.br|access-date=2015-05-22|archive-url=https://archive.today/20150418134045/http://www.mct.gov.br/index.php/content/view/11199/11199.html?nome=&area=Ci%EAncias+Matem%E1ticas&classificacao=&categoria=vivo|archive-date=2015-04-18|url-status=dead}}</ref> Since 2007 he has been a member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="ABC"/>

He is the author of the textbooks ''{{lang|pt|Tópicos de Mecânica Clássica}}'', ''{{lang|pt|Cálculo Tensorial}}'', ''{{lang|pt|Teoria dos Corpos}}'', and ''{{lang|pt|Equações Diferenciais Ordinárias}}''.
